solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Article on bogus medicine man

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece written on another follows it, so the article comes after

parts.note: bogus means fake, a sham
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A news article debunking a fraudulent healer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tribal healer believed to use spirit contact is often called a medicine man.

clue.text: Lack of time after attempt to cross river

indicators.note: after places this piece behind the other
to cross means the attempt goes across, round, the river letter

parts.note: a shot is an attempt
an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: Running out of time after trying to get over a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A shortage is a deficiency or lack of something needed.

clue.text: Subsequently taking supervisory control of post-operative support

parts.note: after means subsequently, later
care is charge or supervision, as in 'in the care of'

explanation.surface: Hospital staff later overseeing a patient's recovery.
explanation.definitionFit: Aftercare is the follow-up treatment given to a patient after surgery.

clue.text: Assist in wrongdoing when helping to make Mugabe triumphant

indicators.note: helping to make says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Accomplices aiding the Zimbabwean leader Mugabe to victory.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition took in 'when', which is only a link word: the verb alone is 'Assist in wrongdoing'.
explanation.definitionFit: To abet is to encourage or help someone commit a crime.

clue.text: Likely to happen when Pearl and Bob break up

indicators.note: the names break up, their letters scattered and reassembled

explanation.surface: Gossip predicting that a couple called Pearl and Bob will split.
explanation.definitionFit: Something probable is expected to occur, a direct synonym.

clue.text: About to put clothes on? Correct

parts.note: re means about, concerning
to dress is to put clothes on

explanation.surface: Someone about to get dressed, then a one-word reply of approval.
explanation.definitionFit: To redress is to set right a wrong, so it means to correct as a verb.

clue.text: What Andy Murray might produce as a bribe

definitions.meaning: the British tennis player hits a backhand stroke
slang for an illicit payment slipped to someone

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a tennis star might offer an illicit payment.
explanation.definitionFit: A tennis shot played with the back of the hand forward, and slang for a secret pay-off.

clue.text: Foreign language graduate needs books on the capital of Uruguay

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate
NT, the New Testament, is a set of books

indicators.note: the capital of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A language graduate needing texts about Montevideo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' tempts towards Montevideo; it means the initial letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Bantu is a family of African languages, foreign to an English speaker.

clue.text: Called up first lady touring Oklahoma on December 1

indicators.note: touring means going round the state letters

parts.note: Eve, the first woman in Genesis
OK is the postal abbreviation for Oklahoma

indicators.note: 1 here means the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A president's wife phoned while touring Oklahoma on the first of December.
explanation.definitionFit: To evoke a memory is to summon or bring it to mind.

clue.text: Nonsense served up about sin causes extreme fear

indicators.note: about means the reversed word goes round the sin
served up in a down clue reverses the word, reading it upwards

parts.note: rot means nonsense
to err is to sin

explanation.surface: Rubbish talk about sin frightening people.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'served up' means read upwards, reversed; 'about' then wraps that reversed word round the sin.
explanation.definitionFit: Terror is intense dread, the strongest form of fear.

clue.text: Becoming better when working close by them

parts.note: a machine that is working is on
a close is an end, as the close of day

explanation.surface: Someone recovering when working near certain people.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for recovering from illness or improving after a bad spell.

clue.text: A masterstroke reportedly to take in the outskirts of Nanking by river

indicators.note: to take in means the sound-word swallows the next piece
reportedly signals that the word is taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: a coup is a brilliant stroke, pronounced 'coo'

indicators.note: the outskirts of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A brilliant military move around the edges of the Chinese city Nanking.
explanation.walkthrough: COUP is said 'coo', written COO; it takes in NG, the outer letters of Nanking.
explanation.definitionFit: The Congo is a great African waterway, so it serves as an example of a river.

clue.text: Head coming around over right to convert

indicators.note: coming around says the head word goes round the letter for right
over signals the combined letters are flipped, read backwards

parts.note: nut is slang for the head

explanation.surface: A leader swinging round to the political right in order to win people over.
explanation.walkthrough: NUT goes round R to make NRUT; 'over' turns that back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn something is to change it into something else, as milk turns to cheese.

clue.text: Eco-friendly place used for cultivation

parts.note: an environmentally friendly building would be a '...', while the glass structure for growing plants carries the joined name

explanation.definitionFit: A glass building where plants are grown is literally a place used for cultivation.

clue.text: They are copied in part by workers in the fashion industry

parts.note: a role is a part in a play
models are the people who wear clothes on the catwalk

explanation.surface: Fashion workers whose styles are imitated in part.
explanation.definitionFit: Role models are people others imitate, so they are the ones copied.

clue.text: German film star's fascinating beauty

parts.note: Dorothy Lamour was a Hollywood film star of the 1930s and 40s

explanation.surface: Praise for the alluring looks of a German movie actress.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamour is an alluring attractiveness, a captivating beauty.

clue.text: A star gets the German part

parts.note: the sun is a star
der is a German word for 'the'

explanation.surface: An actor landing the German role in a production.
explanation.walkthrough: 'part' looks like a noun, a role; it is the verb, to split.
explanation.definitionFit: To sunder is to split apart, so it is a literary synonym for part as a verb.

clue.text: Free, without having to make a speech around Newcastle area

parts.note: ex means without, as in ex dividend

indicators.note: around means the speech word goes round the area letters

parts.note: to orate is to make a speech
NE, the North East, is the region of England containing Newcastle

explanation.surface: Released without needing to give a speech in the North East of England.
explanation.definitionFit: To exonerate is to clear of blame, so it means to free from an accusation.

clue.text: Manage to see gripping paintings mounted in sequence

indicators.note: gripping means the seeing word holds the reversed art inside it

parts.note: to sight is to manage to see, to spot

indicators.note: mounted in a down clue means the word goes upward, reversed

parts.note: paintings are art

explanation.surface: Spotting pictures hung up in order at a gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounted' turns ART to TRA, gripped by SIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: Straight can mean consecutive, as in winning three games straight.

clue.text: An inscription providing information on the French duke

indicators.note: in an across clue the information written on the French article comes after it

parts.note: le is French for 'the'
gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: A plaque giving details about a French nobleman.
explanation.definitionFit: A legend can be the wording on a coin, medal or monument, an inscription.

clue.text: God following absolutely expressionless

indicators.note: following puts the god after the other piece

parts.note: dead means absolutely, as in dead right
Pan, the Greek god of the wild

explanation.surface: A god coming after something utterly without feeling.
explanation.definitionFit: Deadpan describes a deliberately blank face or tone.

clue.text: Look for drugs in abandoned souk near centre of Batna

indicators.note: in places the drugs inside the rearranged market letters
abandoned suggests wild, unrestrained, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: E is ecstasy, so two Es are drugs

indicators.note: centre of picks the middle letter of the word

explanation.surface: Searching for narcotics in a deserted market near an Algerian city centre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' is the anagram signal, not a description of the market; two Es (ecstasy) go inside the rearranged letters. Batna is a city in Algeria.
explanation.definitionFit: To seek out something is to search for it actively, hunt it down.

clue.text: An element of surprise at first over the Italian priest turning up

indicators.note: at first picks the first letter of the word

parts.note: il is Italian for 'the'

indicators.note: turning up in a down clue reverses the word

parts.note: Rev, Reverend, is a priest

explanation.surface: A surprise as an Italian clergyman appears.
explanation.definitionFit: Silver is a chemical element, symbol Ag, so it is an example of an element.

clue.text: We object after broadcast on British passenger transport

indicators.note: after places this piece behind the others

parts.note: to air is to broadcast
us is the object form of 'we'

explanation.surface: A protest after a broadcast about British transport.
explanation.walkthrough: 'We object' looks like a protest; it is the grammatical object form of 'we'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Airbus is a make of airliner carrying passengers.

clue.text: To be kept sacred in a bottle they say and left in Lincoln

indicators.note: they say signals that the words are taken by sound

parts.note: a vial is a small bottle, so 'in vial' means in a bottle

indicators.note: in places the letter for left within the president's name

parts.note: Abe Lincoln, the US president

explanation.surface: Instructions for preserving something holy by bottling it, plus a note about Lincoln.
explanation.walkthrough: A vial is a small bottle; 'in vial' said aloud gives the first part. Abe is President Lincoln's familiar name.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inviolable must never be broken or profaned, so it is to be kept sacred.

clue.text: A house in Virginia habouring evil

indicators.note: harbouring, printed without its R, means holding inside

parts.note: ill means evil, as in ill deeds

explanation.surface: A Virginian home sheltering wickedness.
explanation.definitionFit: A villa is a large country or holiday house.

clue.text: Letters from another American goddess

indicators.note: Letters from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Correspondence from a second American, a woman of godlike charm.
explanation.definitionFit: Hera is the queen of the Greek gods, so she is an example of a goddess.

clue.text: About to be raised after nurse oddly neglected an addict

indicators.note: after places the reversed piece behind the kept letters
oddly neglected discards the odd letters and keeps the even ones
to be raised in a down clue means the word reads upward, reversed

parts.note: re means about

explanation.surface: Someone about to be promoted after a nurse carelessly neglected a drug addict.
explanation.definitionFit: A user is slang for someone who takes drugs habitually.

clue.text: Drivel showing little thought about the end of innocence

indicators.note: about signals the word is turned round

parts.note: glib means superficial and thoughtless

indicators.note: the end of picks the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: A critic dismissing a work that thinks little about losing innocence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns GLIB into BILG, then E is added.
explanation.definitionFit: Bilge is slang for nonsense, worthless talk.

clue.text: Insist on taking criminal band with force

parts.note: to press is to insist, urge
a gang is a criminal band

explanation.surface: Demanding that a gang of crooks be dealt with forcibly.
explanation.definitionFit: To press-gang someone is to coerce them, originally into naval service.

clue.text: American actress needing good final performance

parts.note: Gloria Swanson, star of Sunset Boulevard

explanation.surface: A Hollywood actress needing a fine farewell appearance.
explanation.definitionFit: A swan song is the last act of a career, from the myth that swans sing before dying.

clue.text: Burning old forest trees primarily

parts.note: the Forest of Arden, an ancient English woodland of Shakespeare's As You Like It

indicators.note: primarily picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: An ancient woodland's trees on fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardent means passionate, fiery, and literally glowing or aflame.
